title: External architecture integration decisions and minimum POC boundaries
objective: Read the verified external research package and the landed local project architecture, Harness, PR #15 evidence, and PR #16 program files. Produce six decision reports that map existing capability overlap, adopt or reject external approaches, identify architecture conflicts and overengineering, defer Live Observation work, and define three minimum non-implementing POCs: SOL-PARSER-COMPARISON-POC-001, SHADOW-REPLAY-MINIMUM-LOOP-POC-001, and BSC-EXISTING-DATA-INVENTORY-POC-001. Optimize for Windows-local, low-cost, second-to-minute research, about one thousand addresses with dozens of focus wallets, no real trades, and explicit unknown or unfillable outputs. Do not modify product code, PR #15, PR #16, existing product task specs, dependencies, or implement any POC.
forbidden_actions: Do not read chainfm_out, GMGN private exports, real wallet addresses or transaction details, private keys, mnemonics, cookies, browser sessions, or login state.
Do not read any external-research path except raw-reports, source-catalog, verified-findings, and the three named repository directories under EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_ROOT.
Do not make network requests, collect live chain data, crawl blocks, use Live Observation, execute trades, or connect Yellowstone.
Do not modify product source, tests, database migrations, PR #15, PR #16, or any existing product task spec.
Do not add dependencies, run third-party repository code, copy repositories into the project, or commit the external research workspace.

Do not implement any POC; describe only bounded inputs, write set, forbidden actions, dependency boundary, fixed commit, offline/online boundary, criteria, scope caps, decision, and PR #16 Task impact.
Do not write outside the declared repository write_set or the six authorized external synthesis files.
If data is absent, record unknown or unfillable; do not infer or fabricate fields.
